correctness.rationale: Stationary weight π∝∏q_L^{dη_d} follows branch detailed balance and uniform circulating ring balance; exact ring current Δ E[B_L(L−B_L)]/[L(L−1)] includes canonical finite correlation. Bernoulli conditioning at unique µ_L turns finite partition into conditional independent site variables; µ_L→µ and a uniform triangular-array local CLT yields B_L fluctuations with harmonic-variance v_b v_t/(v_b+v_t); conditional subgaussian domination ensures second-moment convergence beyond weak CLT. Exchangeability gives L Cov(η_i,η_j)→−v_b²/(v_b+v_t). Implicit derivative df/dλ<0 and limiting density endpoints imply unique f=1/2 for 1/2<ρ<c+1/2, and current Δ/4. Expansion J_L/Δ=1/4+(1/4−v_*)/L+o(1/L) gives strictly positive coefficient. Independently numerically solved c=.75,ρ=.95 yielding λ*=1.0962176457,v*=.10383757025, excess=.14616242975; these finite calculations do not prove local CLT.
